interpretation_guardrails: Teacher-fidelity metrics measure imitation of Jev, not ground-truth correctness.
Official-label metrics measure benchmark performance; Jev comparisons use the 1,174-row teacher-paired subset.
No final held-out result was used to select hyperparameters or adapters.
BeaverTails is not included in this run and remains an external test.

protocol.external_test: BeaverTails remains untouched during training and CV.
protocol.final_test_scope: All 1,180 rows from the six official held-out benchmarks for official-label metrics; teacher-fidelity metrics use only the 1,174 rows with released Jev probabilities.
protocol.train_scope: Only hill-climb rows with a released cached Jev probability; the same 3,777 rows are used for every arm.
